Paragraph: Then the destroyer of enemies Hanuma discarding the guise of ascetic assumed his original monkey form, and on producing fire with two sticks then made it to glow. decorated, worshipped with flowers, then gladly and devoutly placed that fire in between Rama and Sugreeva.
Situation/Problem_Faced: Witnessing and sanctifying the alliance with sacred ritual.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Hanuman kindles sacred fire to act as witness to the pact.
Outcome/Resolution: The friendship is sanctified before the divine element of fire.

Mental_Health_Theme_Synonyms.Work-Life Balance: Dutiful ritual facilitation and spiritual mindfulness

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Agni-sakshi (making fire the sacred witness to a vow)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Sanctifying human/divine bonds in the presence of Agni, the sacred witness.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Using ritual framing to enhance the psychological weight and permanence of a commitment.
